items.title: Paul Barnes Interview, 1971-03-13
items.q: Ray Allen came back home. He came back later. But I stayed in New York, I stayed there about five years after that.

ctx.x: Great kind of guy. Darnell Harris?

No. No, Darnell Harris, in fact Darnell Harris taken his place. Oh really? In Chicago. And you knew him too. Yeah, he went away to Paris, France with Wilbur. Oh, I love that. Wilbur to Paris. Simeon. Oh, Omar. Omar Simeon. Yeah, that was our read section. Well we had a good band and so I won't get off that, but the band broke up because we were supposed to go in the cotton club and King Oliver wanted too much money, so instead the band got Duke Ellington. And that's why King Oliver made his mistake, because his…
I see. That's how you got up with Jell-A. Yeah, that's how I got up with Jell-A-Roll-Martin. Because King Oliver's band broke up.

items.title: Paul Barnes Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: I in turn helped Ray Allen... What kind of music did that band play? I mean you know the band with Ray Allen and Lawrence

ctx.x: Yeah, Lawrence Morera and Joe Saia. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Who was Bush? Bush was a trumpet player. He was a fine trumpet player. He came up under Buddy P.T. Buddy P.T. was his instructor. He was the only one in the band who could read music. He helped me and Lawrence and the rest of the show to play the music. So I in turn helped Ray Allen. Yeah.
What was Bush's name? Bush Hall.
